Definition: from the base of G664; (figuratively) decisiveness, i.e. rigor:--severity.
BiblicalUsage: Paul sets God's goodness and His severity side by side: severity toward those who fell, goodness toward those who continue in His goodness. The word is decisiveness, the sharp edge of a God who means what He says.
TheologicalSignificance: A God with no severity would have no goodness worth trusting.
